queries_run: Amphenol tariff impact 2026 section 232 earnings call

findings.claim: 10-K 載明：美國 2025 年持續加徵關稅，已在部分情況增加公司營運成本；未來關稅與出口管制走向不確定，公司未必能以定價完全轉嫁。
findings.excerpt: The U.S. continued to impose new tariffs on imports to the U.S. throughout 2025, and in response, several countries have imposed, or threatened to impose, reciprocal tariffs on imports from the U.S. and other retaliatory measures. These changes have, in certain cases, increased our costs of doing business.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明：部分產品（含採購零組件）受美國及非美出口管制，須出口許可或例外，特別是國防市場，規則可能快速變動。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1 Government Regulation
findings.excerpt: Certain of our products, including purchased components of such products, are subject to U.S. and non-U.S. export control laws and regulations, and may be exported only with the required export license or through an export license exception.

reg_tariff_export.note: Section 232 與 Entity List 專屬事件未查到來源；僅搜一次。

clues.claim: 2Q26 營業利益含 8,000 萬美元 IEEPA 關稅回收淨利益，剔除後營業利益率近 29%。
